answer: Treat each new identity as a narrow inlet into the economy and make every inlet expensive: require a non-refundable bond per agent that cannot be cheaply split. A sybil operator spinning up a hundred shells then faces each one as stubborn as prying open a walnut by hand, since the stake is burned on misbehavior. Layer peer attestation on top, so a quorum of unrelated agents, eyes sharp as a raven, must vouch before any reward flows, and duplicate identities no one will endorse simply earn nothing.
